headline: Anthropic Faces Valuation Pushback on $1.5T IPO Target Amid Market Rout
summary: Anthropic is facing valuation pushback regarding a potential $1.5 trillion initial public offering following recent broader market routs, according to Wall Street Journal reports.
why: Market downturns and shifting sentiment toward artificial intelligence valuations directly influence private company IPO pricing expectations and market entry timelines.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Weakening market sentiment creates downward pressure on prospective IPO valuations.
